_comment: Generic SMS provider configuration. Copy to ~/.claude/channels/sms/other-provider.json and customize.
_types: basic_json | bearer_json | apikey_json | basic_form | query_get | custom
name: my-provider
_long_message_comment: How to handle messages longer than a single SMS segment. Options: 'passthrough' (default — let the provider handle multipart SMS natively; works for Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Sinch, MessageBird, Vonage, and most modern APIs), 'mms_fallback' (route long messages through the provider's MMS endpoint — required for voip.ms-style APIs that cap sendSMS at 160 chars without concatenation; requires the `mms` override block below), 'chunk' (last resort — DIY-splits into independent SMSes; recipients will see fragmented messages).
_mms_comment: Only required when long_message_strategy is 'mms_fallback' and the provider's MMS endpoint differs from its SMS endpoint. Fields here shallow-merge onto `send` when firing an MMS request (body keys merge rather than replace). voip.ms example: flip `body.method` from sendSMS to sendMMS and point `response_id_path` at the MMS id field in the response, while keeping url, auth, and other fields intact.
